ocean.title: Some stories begin quietly.
ocean.subtitle: Every person deserves a documentary.
ocean.enteredMessage: Take your time. Your story is already here.

recorder.title: The Recorder
recorder.welcome1: I want to record today's you.
recorder.introQuestion: Tell me — what is the first thing that comes to you?
recorder.placeholder: Begin with what you can see...
recorder.modeTitle: How would you like to begin?
recorder.modeSubtitle: There is no wrong way. Choose a path.
recorder.modeRandomDesc: Let chance open a door. We'll wander through whatever surfaces.
recorder.modeGuidedDesc: I'll lead you gently — scene, then memory, then feeling, then meaning.
recorder.openingQuestion:
If your life was a documentary,
what would the first scene be?
recorder.fallback: Take your time. Even a single image is enough to begin.

place: What did that place look like?
What sounds did you hear there?
person: What did they say or do?
emotion: How do you feel when you remember it?
Where in your body do you notice it?
scene: If the camera stayed, what would it catch?
What sat at the edge of the frame?
meaning: Why do you think it stayed with you?
What does it mean to you now?

doorsDefault: Stay with that image a moment.

emotion: Where in your body does {thing} live?
moment: What did you see in that moment?
